lines: For the full year 2026, Hubbell anticipates total sales growth of 18-19%, including organic sales growth of 10-11%.
Hubbell expects 2026 GAAP diluted earnings per share in the range of $17.30 to $17.50 and adjusted diluted earnings per share (“Adjusted EPS”) in the range of $20.40 to $20.60.

For the full year, Adjusted EPS excludes amortization of acquisition-related intangible assets, which the Company expects to be approximately $2.50 per share, and transaction, integration, and separation costs, which the Company expects to be approximately $0.60 per share.
The Company expects full year 2026 free cash flow conversion of approximately 90% on adjusted net income.
